issues.problem: Intro said -aru verbs are 'always' intransitive and -su verbs 'always' transitive; 預かる/教わる and 暮らす are exceptions.
issues.action: Stated the rule with its exceptions.

issues.problem: tr-narabu rule claimed that in -u/-eru pairs the -eru verb is transitive (false for 割る・割れる, 焼く・焼ける) and listed かける (an -aru/-eru pair) under it.
issues.action: Rule now limited to this set; explain names the reversed pairs.

issues.problem: Mistake note said 橋を渡す would mean handing the bridge to someone; it actually means laying a bridge.
tr-okiru rule generalised '-u/-eru and -aru/-eru pairs: -eru transitive'; explain and tip said every -su verb is transitive.
issues.action: Rule scoped to 育てる/温める; 暮らす exception added; tip no longer says 'every time'.

issues.problem: 起こされる contrast said the passive is correct only when the waker is in view; 雷の音で起こされた is also normal.
Intro and explain said the thing is always marked with が and the doer is never mentioned; X を + てある also occurs.
issues.action: Said が is the default and mentioned X を + てある.

issues.problem: Step 4 claimed -su always transitive, -aru always intransitive, and -eru always transitive in -u/-eru pairs, which contradicts the guide's own 割る・割れる mistake.
issues.action: Rewrote step 4 with 暮らす, 預かる and 割る・割れる / 焼く・焼ける exceptions.

issues.problem: を-exception for intransitives covered only the route crossed, not the place left (家を出る).
issues.action: Added 出る to explain and pattern.
